# Strumm — Music Ecosystem

> Strumm is a premium, handcrafted music ecosystem. AI-powered playlists, podcast support, synced lyrics, listening analytics, and social music discovery — ad-free and private.

## Key Features

- **Strumm Flow**: AI-powered music curation and smart playlist builder
- **Strumm Replay**: Personalized listening dashboard with Sound DNA (Energy, Discovery, Nostalgia, Variety, Repeat Rate)
- **Sound DNA**: Five-dimensional analysis of listening patterns
- **Playlists**: Create, curate, and import playlists from YouTube
- **Podcasts**: Subscribe to RSS podcast feeds and stream episodes
- **Lyrics**: Synced lyrics display via LRCLIB
- **Circle**: Social music connections with friend activity, shared listening, and blend playlists
- **Rooms**: Collaborative shared listening rooms
- **Discovery Mix**: AI-curated recommendations via Groq
- **Dynamic Themes**: 8 handcrafted themes (Obsidian, Black Cherry, Ocean Drive, Vinyl Classic, Monochrome, Aurora, Sunset Blvd, Rose Garden, Cyberpunk)
- **PWA**: Progressive Web App with install support
- **Player Sync**: Cross-device player state synchronization
- **Privacy**: No ads, no tracking, no data selling

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (React), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zustand
- **Backend**: Python FastAPI with MongoDB (via Motor)
- **AI**: Groq API for music recommendations
- **Streaming**: YouTube iframe API
- **Auth**: JWT tokens (bcrypt-hashed passwords) + Google OAuth
- **Email**: Resend / SMTP
- **Real-time**: WebSocket connections
- **Hosting**: Render (backend), Vercel/Cloudflare (frontend)
